46807-lyman-s-history-of-old-walla-walla.creator: Unknown
46807-lyman-s-history-of-old-walla-walla.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. A land of scenic charm, of physical interest, of fertile soil and ample resources, of climate in which living is a delight, of two great rivers and many impetuous tributaries, of mountain chains with rich and varied hues and contours of stately majesty,--such is the imperial domain included in that portion of the State of Washington lying east of the Columbia River and south of the Snake.

70143-frank-allen-at-old-moose-lake.title: The Trail in the Snow
70143-frank-allen-at-old-moose-lake.creator: Graham B. Forbes
70143-frank-allen-at-old-moose-lake.description: A book by Graham B. Forbes. I thought you were calling hogs or selling peanuts!” called Frank, while Lanky swung the gun quickly from his shoulder as if he might bring it up to kill such an insulting speaker. “Be down in a minute!” called Frank again, as he slammed the window to the bottom and disappeared into his room. In a few minutes the two boys were together on the street, each with his rifle, headed for the homes of other boys.

arxiv-2109-04542.title: Characterization of the continuous transition from atomic to molecular shape in the three-body Coulomb system
arxiv-2109-04542.creator: Laura D. Salas, Bárbara Zamora-Yusti, Julio C. Arce
arxiv-2109-04542.description: Abstract We present an alternative, univocal characterization of the continuous transition from atomic to molecular shape in the Coulomb system constituted by two identical particles and a third particle with the opposite charge, as the mass ratio of the particles varies.

arxiv-2201-09999.title: Quantum Limits to Classically Spoofing an Electromagnetic Signal
arxiv-2201-09999.creator: Jonathan N. Blakely, Shawn D. Pethel
arxiv-2201-09999.description: Abstract Spoofing an electromagnetic signal involves measuring its properties and preparing a spoof signal that is a close enough copy to fool a receiver. A classic application of spoofing is in radar where an airborne target attempts to avoid being tracked by a ground-based radar by emitting pulses indicating a false range or velocity.

arxiv-2203-09333.title: Modulated Contrast for Versatile Image Synthesis
arxiv-2203-09333.creator: Fangneng Zhan, Jiahui Zhang, Yingchen Yu, Rongliang Wu, Shijian Lu
arxiv-2203-09333.description: Abstract Perceiving the similarity between images has been a long-standing and fundamental problem underlying various visual generation tasks. Predominant approaches measure the inter-image distance by computing pointwise absolute deviations, which tends to estimate the median of instance distributions and leads to blurs and artifacts in the generated images.

arxiv-2208-08258.title: Activity-driven tissue alignment in proliferating spheroids
arxiv-2208-08258.creator: Liam J. Ruske, Julia M. Yeomans
arxiv-2208-08258.description: Abstract We extend the continuum theory of active nematic fluids to study cell flows and tissue dynamics inside multicellular spheroids, spherical, self-assembled aggregates of cells that are widely used as model systems to study tumour dynamics. Cells near the surface of spheroids have better access to nutrients and therefore proliferate more rapidly than those in the resource-depleted core.

arxiv-2212-09902.title: Dexterous Manipulation from Images: Autonomous Real-World RL via Substep Guidance Thanks: *Both authors contributed equally Thanks: https://sites.google.com/view/dexterous-avail/
arxiv-2212-09902.creator: Kelvin Xu Zheyuan Hu Ria Doshi Aaron Rovinsky Vikash Kumar Abhishek Gupta Sergey Levine
arxiv-2212-09902.description: Abstract Complex and contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks, particularly those that involve multi-fingered hands and underactuated object manipulation, present a significant challenge to any control method. Methods based on reinforcement learning offer an appealing choice for such settings, as they can enable robots to learn to delicately balance contact forces and dexterously reposition objects without strong modeling assumptions.

arxiv-2311-05346.title: Accelerated Shapley Value Approximation for Data Evaluation
arxiv-2311-05346.creator: Lauren Watson, Zeno Kujawa, Rayna Andreeva, Hao-Tsung Yang, Tariq Elahi, Rik Sarkar
arxiv-2311-05346.description: Abstract Data valuation has found various applications in machine learning, such as data filtering, efficient learning and incentives for data sharing. The most popular current approach to data valuation is the Shapley value. While popular for its various applications, Shapley value is computationally expensive even to approximate, as it requires repeated iterations of training models on different subsets of data.

arxiv-2403-06727.title: Minimisers of supremal functionals and mass-minimising 1 1 -currents
arxiv-2403-06727.creator: Nikos Katzourakis, Roger Moser
arxiv-2403-06727.description: Abstract We study vector-valued functions that minimise the L ∞ L^{\infty} -norm of their derivatives for prescribed boundary data. We construct a vector-valued, mass minimising 1 1 -current (i.e., a generalised geodesic) in the domain such that all solutions of the problem coincide on its support. Furthermore, this current can be interpreted as a streamline of the solutions.

arxiv-2406-10707.title: DataStates-LLM : Lazy Asynchronous Checkpointing for Large Language Models
arxiv-2406-10707.creator: Avinash Maurya, Robert Underwood, M. Mustafa Rafique, Franck Cappello, Bogdan Nicolae
arxiv-2406-10707.description: Abstract . LLMs have seen rapid adoption in all domains. They need to be trained on high-end high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructures and ingest massive amounts of input data. Unsurprisingly, at such a large scale, unexpected events (e.g., failures of components, instability of the software, undesirable learning patterns, etc.), are frequent and typically impact the training in a negative fashion.

arxiv-2502-09986.title: Statistical modeling of categorical trajectories with multivariate functional principal components
arxiv-2502-09986.creator: Hervé Cardot, Caroline Peltier
arxiv-2502-09986.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hervé Cardot, Caroline Peltier. There are many examples in which the statistical units of interest are samples of a continuous time categorical random process, that is to say a continuous time stochastic process taking values in a finite state space. Without loosing any information, we associate to each state a binary random function, taking values in { 0 , 1 } \{0,1\} , and turn the problem of statistical modeling of a categorical process into a multivariate functional data analysis issue.

arxiv-2507-11689.title: REST in Pieces: RESTful Design Rule Violations in Student-Built Web Apps Thanks: This work has been partially supported by the Italian PNRR MUR project PE0000013-FAIR.
arxiv-2507-11689.creator: Sergio Di Meglio, Valeria Pontillo, Luigi Libero Lucio Starace
arxiv-2507-11689.description: Abstract In Computer Science Bachelor’s programs, software quality is often underemphasized due to limited time and a focus on foundational skills, leaving many students unprepared for industry expectations. To better understand the typical quality of student code and inform both education and hiring practices, we analyze 40 full-stack web applications developed in a third-year Web Technologies course.

arxiv-2507-18530.title: Deep learning-enabled large-scale analysis of particle geometry-lithiation correlations in battery cathode materials Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2507-18530.creator: Binbin Lin, Luis J. Carrillo, Xiang-Long Peng, Wan-Xin Chen, David A. Santos, Sarbajit Banerjee, Bai-Xiang Xu
arxiv-2507-18530.description: Abstract A deep learning model is employed to address the challenging problem of V 2 O 5 nanoparticle segmentation and the correlation between the chemical composition and the geometrical features of lithiated V 2 O 5 nanoparticles as an exemplar of a phase-transforming battery cathode material.

pmc-11349549.title: A nomogram prediction of coronary artery dilation in Kawasaki diseases based on mtDNA copy number
pmc-11349549.creator: Mou Peng, Peng Yue, Yue Zhang, Hong Li, Yimin Hua, Yifei Li, Hong Zheng, Fangfei Liu
pmc-11349549.description: ObjectiveThe level of mitochondrial DNA copy number (mtDNA-CN) in peripheral blood cells had been identified to be involved in several immune and cardiovascular diseases. Thus, the aim of this study is to evaluate the levels of mtDNA-CN in Kawasaki disease (KD) and to construct a nomogram prediction for coronary artery lesions in children with KD.

pmc-11356592.title: Crystal Lattice Recovery and Optical Activation of Yb Implanted into β-Ga2O3
pmc-11356592.creator: Mahwish Sarwar, Renata Ratajczak, Vitalii Yu. Ivanov, Sylwia Gieraltowska, Aleksandra Wierzbicka, Wojciech Wozniak, René Heller, Stefan Eisenwinder, Elżbieta Guziewicz
pmc-11356592.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). β-Ga2O3 is an ultra-wide bandgap semiconductor (Eg~4.8 eV) of interest for many applications, including optoelectronics. Undoped Ga2O3 emits light in the UV range that can be tuned to the visible region of the spectrum by rare earth dopants. In this work, we investigate the crystal lattice recovery of (2¯01)-oriented β-Ga2O3 crystals implanted with Yb ions to the fluence of 1 ×1014 at/cm2.

pmc-11434720.title: Comparative Chemical Analysis and Bioactive Properties of Aqueous and Glucan-Rich Extracts of Three Widely Appreciated Mushrooms: Agaricus bisporus (J.E.Lange) Imbach, Laetiporus sulphureus (Bull.) Murill and Agrocybe aegerita (V. Brig.) Vizzini
pmc-11434720.creator: Jovana Petrović, Jasmina Glamočlija, Danijel D. Milinčić, Ana Doroški, Steva Lević, Slađana P. Stanojević, Aleksandar Ž. Kostić, Dušanka A. Popović Minić, Bojana B. Vidović, Ana Plećić, Viktor A. Nedović, Mirjana B. Pešić, Dejan Stojković
pmc-11434720.description: Herein we describe the antioxidant, antimicrobial, antibiofilm, anti-inflammatory and wound-healing potential of aqueous and polysaccharide extracts from three widely appreciated mushrooms: Agrocybe aegerita, Laetiporus sulphureus and Agaricus bisporus. Moreover, we present their detailed phenolic, polysaccharide and protein profiles and ATR-FTIR spectra.

pmc-11478368.title: Abstracts of the 2024 50th Annual NATAS Conference
pmc-11478368.creator: Rigoberto Advincula, Christopher Bowman, Dennis Smith, Karl Schoch, Tina Adams, Cathy Stewart, Lawrence Judovits, Louis Pilato, Alexander Böker
pmc-11478368.description: The 50th annual conference of the North American Thermal Analysis Society is being held jointly with the 8th Baekeland Symposium to bring those communities together. NATAS offers scientists and practitioners the opportunity to explore the frontiers of thermal analysis, rheology, and materials characterization, learn of developments in instrumentation and software, as well as applications in a variety of industrial settings.

pmc-11640152.title: Dietary 25-Hydroxycholecalciferol Supplementation from Day 85 of Gestation to Farrowing Enhances Performance, Antioxidant Capacity, and Immunoglobulins of Sows and Newborn Piglets
pmc-11640152.creator: Shenfei Long, Shad Mahfuz, Xiangshu Piao, Sylwester Świątkiewicz
pmc-11640152.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple Summary25-hydroxycholecalciferol has been widely used to increase the calcium and phosphorus absorption in lactating sows, while there have been only a few studies focusing on its effect on performance and health status of gestating sows and their offsprings.

pmc-12720631.title: Acute kidney injury after lung transplantation: prediction, prevention, and management
pmc-12720631.creator: Chongyang Ye, Jian Huang, Tingting Ye, Li Ke, XianLiang Jiang, Chunyan Zhu
pmc-12720631.description: Acute kidney injury (AKI) following lung transplantation is a significant complication that affects postoperative outcomes and survival rates among patients. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the mechanisms underlying the occurrence of AKI post-lung transplantation, identifies key risk factors, and discusses various predictive models that have been developed in this field.

pmc-12798867.title: Characteristics and Correlates of Mirror Movements in Parkinson’s Disease
pmc-12798867.creator: Pritish Gupta, Manavjot Singh, Birinder Singh Paul, Manraj Singh, Sidakbir Singh Paul
pmc-12798867.description: Background and Objectives:This study aimed to assess the frequency, characteristics, and clinical associations of mirror movements in individuals with Parkinson’s disease, considering factors such as age, side of symptom onset, disease severity, and motor asymmetry.Methods:This cross-sectional observational study included 87 individuals with Parkinson’s disease, diagnosed according to Movement Disorder Society criteria.

pmc-13088909.title: Electrochemical functionalization of pyridines
pmc-13088909.creator: Satabdi Bera, Tushar Singha, Nakul Abhay Bapat, Durga Prasad Hari
pmc-13088909.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pyridines are important nitrogen-containing heteroaromatics with wide applications in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, ligands, and materials science. However, their selective C–H functionalization remains challenging due to low nucleophilicity, regioselectivity issues, and catalyst deactivation via nitrogen coordination. Traditional methods such as electrophilic substitution, directed metalation, transition-metal catalysis, and N-oxide transformations have enabled significant advances in this field, but often require harsh conditions or pre-functionalized substrates.

pmc-13169950.title: Attitude and compliance of dental assistants towards infection control: A quasi-experimental study
pmc-13169950.creator: Faiza Ali, Rizwan Khalil, George Samuel, Rashna Hoshang Sukhia
pmc-13169950.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Objectives:The primary objective was to conduct a PDSA cycle on the infection control practices of dental assistants. The secondary objective of the study was to record the knowledge, attitudes, and perceptions of dental assistants regarding infection control practices.Methodology:The 15 months (December 2022- February 2024) quasi-experimental study followed a PDSA cycle with a sample size of 22 selected via non-probability purposive sampling. During the Planning Phase, a proforma was developed, and evaluators were trained for data collection.

pmc-13403706.title: Direct superior ophthalmic vein puncture for cavernous sinus dural arteriovenous fistula with dual orbital venous outflow: illustrative case
pmc-13403706.creator: Nanako Miki, Hideo Chihara, So Matsukawa, Taichi Ikedo, Shigeki Takada, Masakazu Okawa, Takayuki Kikuchi, Chiaki Sakai, Yoshiki Arakawa

pmc-13491482.title: Preparation and Evaluation of Biopolysaccharide-Based Temperature-Resistant Drilling Fluid Additives
pmc-13491482.creator: Yunhai Zhao, Yu Fan, Jiayin Zhang, Yu Zhang, Jingqi Shi, Chao Wen, Zhichao Xie
pmc-13491482.description: Xanthan gum (XG), valued for its environmental friendliness and multifunctionality, has been extensively utilized in drilling fluids. However, its inadequate thermal stability at elevated bottomhole temperatures encountered in deep drilling operations has constrained its broader application. In this study, we successfully synthesized a graft copolymer (XG-g-Nano SiO2-AMPS) through grafting XG with KH570-modified nano-SiO2 and thermally stable monomer AMPS.

pmc-13627405.title: Case Report: Intracranial hypertension occurring in association with subacute thyroiditis
pmc-13627405.creator: Mariapia Griffo, Chiara Muzio, Elisabetta Bernardi, Matteo Azzimonti, Manuela Pintus, Laura Dell'Arti, Francesco Viola, Stefania Paola Corti
pmc-13627405.description: Subacute thyroiditis (SAT) is a self-limited inflammatory thyroid disorder that typically produces a transient thyrotoxic phase. Intracranial hypertension (IH) is a rare but potentially sight-threatening complication of thyrotoxicosis, reported almost exclusively in hyperthyroidism, with only a single previous report linking it to SAT.

pmc-13637044.title: Cutaneous Manifestations and Dermatologic Adverse Events in IBD: A Clinical Update
pmc-13637044.creator: Dimitrios Tsilimpotis, Georgia Kyriakou, Luc Biedermann, Stephan Vavricka, Thomas Greuter, Gerhard Rogler, Michael Doulberis
pmc-13637044.description: Inflammatory bowel diseases (IBDs), including Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis, are immune-mediated disorders characterized by chronic gastrointestinal inflammation and a broad spectrum of extraintestinal manifestations. Among these, dermatological manifestations significantly impact patients’ quality of life (QoL), presenting as conditions linked to IBD itself or IBD-related medical therapy.

pmc-13647739.title: Dual-attention temporal graph neural network on resting-state fMRI dynamic functional connectivity identifies risk-related patterns of migraine chronification
pmc-13647739.creator: Chun-Yang Xu, Song-Hua Zhan, Zhen Gong, Min Zhang, Yu Wu, Rong-Fang Guo, Ying-Nan Kong, Yichen Huang, Wen-Li Tan, Yu-Chan Yang
pmc-13647739.description: BackgroundMigraine chronification remains difficult to characterize at the individual level, and robust baseline imaging markers associated with subsequent conversion from episodic migraine (EM) to chronic migraine (CM) are lacking. Resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) dynamic functional connectivity (dFC) captures transient brain network interactions, but conventional approaches provide limited interpretability for clinical translation.

uslaw-cfr-t40-s355-60.title: 40 C.F.R. § 355.60 — What is the relationship between the emergency release notification requirements of this part and the release notification requirements of CERCLA?
